cohort: All consecutive women with Type 1 diabetes treated with continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion and continuous glucose monitoring who were monitored during pregnancy at a high-risk pregnancy clinic at a tertiary medical center between April 2011 and April 2019.
finding: Total insulin requirements significantly increased by 42.1% from conception to delivery in women with T1DM treated with an insulin pump, with no significant main effect of maternal BMI or GWG.
